lifeTimeline.body: The starting point: Qaradag, in the Azerbaijan region of Iran.
lifeTimeline.image_alt: Babak Castle in the Qaradag mountains
details: The origin point is not a credential; it is the place that gives the route its first texture.
It keeps the story grounded before universities, labs, and companies enter the picture.
lifeTimeline.summary: Born in Qaradag, in northwestern Iran.

lifeTimeline.body: Tehran meant four formative years at Sharif University of Technology.
details: Industrial engineering gave me the language of systems, constraints, queues, and trade-offs.
It was the first formal step toward the blend of analytics, optimization, and applied decision work I still use.
lifeTimeline.summary: Four undergraduate years in the capital.

lifeTimeline.body: Istanbul became the long academic chapter: first the MSc, then the PhD at Koc University.
lifeTimeline.image_alt: Koc University Rumelifeneri campus overlooking the Black Sea
details: The master's work turned into a doctoral route through operations research, production systems, and data-driven modeling.
This is where I started treating uncertainty as something to model carefully, not smooth away.
lifeTimeline.summary: Master's study turned into a doctoral chapter.

lifeTimeline.body: A year at Bosch AI working on scheduling, reinforcement learning, search, and industrial data.
lifeTimeline.image_alt: Bosch research campus building in Renningen
details: Bosch put the research inside industrial constraints: scheduling, search, reinforcement learning, and semiconductor data.
It made the work more concrete, because the algorithms had to meet factory-scale messiness.

lifeTimeline.body: I returned to Istanbul to write, defend, and close the PhD.
lifeTimeline.image_alt: Koc University Rumelifeneri campus overlooking the Black Sea
details: The return to Istanbul was about closing the loop: writing, defending, and turning years of work into a finished thesis.
It was the transition point from doctoral research into the next applied chapter.

lifeTimeline.body: The postdoc years expanded the research toolkit, and by the second year the first master's student I supervised had graduated.
lifeTimeline.image_alt: Atlas Building at Eindhoven University of Technology
details: The postdoc years expanded the toolkit into evolutionary training, neural networks, inventory systems, and supervision.
By the end of this chapter, research also meant helping students carry their own work across the finish line.
lifeTimeline.summary: Postdoc years, supervision, and the first master's student graduating.

lifeTimeline.body: The current chapter is Rabobank, value chain finance, and research habits translated into production decisions.
details: The work now sits closer to decisions: portfolio monitoring, credit risk, model governance, and analytics that teams actually use.
The academic habits are still there, but the output has to survive operational, regulatory, and business constraints.
lifeTimeline.summary: Research moved into finance, risk, and portfolio analytics.
